data.title: Rejection of tree-felling exception permit for two lindens
data.summary: The Untere Naturschutzbehörde of Landkreis Musterpeene (Aktenzeichen UNB-67.1-2611/26) rejected Frauke Beispielrade's application to fell two linden trees at Boddenweg 11, finding the trees legally protected under § 18 Naturschutzausführungsgesetz and healthy after inspection on 21 October 2026. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: This letter is a formal decision (Bescheid) from the local nature protection authority refusing your request to cut down two linden trees on your property, because the trees are legally protected and were found healthy and stable by their expert. A crown trim (Kronenschnitt) does not need a permit and remains an option. If you disagree with the rejection, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the authority; the app shows until when you can do this. If you do nothing by then, the rejection becomes final and the trees stay protected. Consider consulting a lawyer or the authority's office if you want to challenge the decision.
